_meta.description: Fictional machine manuals for the PaperOps demo (source for tool search_manual). All data invented.

machines.name: Hydraulic press HP-400
machines.lockout_procedure: Turn main switch Q1 OFF, attach padlock, release hydraulic accumulator via valve V7, pressure gauge must read 0 bar.
machines.lockout_short: Emergency stop: lock out Q1, release V7 to 0 bar.

error_codes.title: Lubrication failure on main axis
causes: Supply line A3 blocked or cracked
error_codes.safety: Lock the emergency stop. Axis can be above 80 °C – wear heat-resistant gloves.
steps: Lock the emergency stop (lockout Q1).
Check supply line A3 for cracks and blockage.
Refill 500 ml lubricating oil ISO VG 46.
Run dosing pump P2 in manual mode for 3 cycles.
Check pressure gauge: target 2.5–3.0 bar.
recurring_root_causes: Supply line A3 blocked or cracked
error_codes.recurring_advice: check dosing pump P2 and supply line A3, don't just refill oil

error_codes.title: Hydraulic pressure too low
error_codes.safety: Release hydraulic accumulator via V7. Oil escaping under pressure can penetrate skin.
steps: Lockout Q1, release accumulator via V7, wait for 0 bar.
Check oil level in sight glass, top up hydraulic oil HLP 46 if needed.
Check differential pressure indicator of hydraulic filter F1; replace if red.
If the cylinder leaks: replace the main cylinder seal kit.
Test stroke without workpiece, pressure must reach 180 bar.

error_codes.title: Light curtain safety field interrupted / faulty
error_codes.safety: SAFETY FUNCTION! Never run the press without a working light curtain. Bypassing is forbidden. Qualified electrician only.
steps: Take the press out of service and attach a 'DO NOT SWITCH ON' sign.
Call a qualified electrician – never bypass.
Clean transmitter and receiver optics with a lint-free cloth.
Check connector X12 for damage.
Run a function test with the 30 mm test rod at 3 points and document it.

machines.name: CNC milling center FZ-65
machines.lockout_procedure: Press emergency stop, turn main switch OFF, attach padlock, wait for spindle to stop.
machines.lockout_short: Emergency stop: lock out main switch, wait for spindle stop.

error_codes.title: Spindle temperature too high
error_codes.safety: Let the spindle cool down for 10 minutes. Coolant: wear skin protection.
steps: Stop the program, press emergency stop, let the spindle cool down.
Check coolant level, top up with 5 % coolant emulsion.
Clean or replace coolant filter KF-2.
Check that the cooling unit fan is running.
Start spindle warm-up program O9001.

error_codes.title: Tool changer blocked
causes: Tool not seated correctly in magazine
error_codes.safety: Do not reach into the magazine while compressed air is connected.
steps: Press emergency stop, shut off compressed air at service unit W1.
Clean chips from gripper and magazine pocket.
Check that the tool holder is seated correctly.
Open compressed air, check target value 6 bar.
Test tool change in setup mode.

error_codes.title: Following error on X axis
steps: Lock out the main switch.
Check central lubrication, refill grease NLGI 2.
Check motor/ball screw coupling for play.
Jog X axis slowly in manual mode, listen for noises.
If the error persists: request a service technician from the manufacturer.

machines.name: Conveyor belt FB-12
machines.lockout_procedure: Pull the emergency pull-cord, switch off and lock drive at switch S4.
machines.lockout_short: Emergency pull-cord: lock out drive S4.

error_codes.title: Motor protection switch tripped
error_codes.safety: Lock drive S4. Never reach into a running belt.
steps: Switch off and lock drive S4.
Unload the belt and check for foreign objects.
Turn the drive roller by hand – if stiff, replace bearing 6205-2RS.
Reset motor protection switch Q4.
Run idle for 2 minutes, check current draw (max. 4.2 A).

error_codes.title: Belt misalignment
steps: Lock drive S4.
Clean residue from the rollers.
Adjust the tension roller on the run-off side by 1/4 turn.
Test run, repeat until the belt runs centered.

machines.name: Welding robot SR-16
machines.lockout_procedure: Open cell door only after robot safety stop, key switch to T1, lock main switch.
machines.lockout_short: Robot safety stop: key switch to T1, lock out main switch.

error_codes.title: Wire feed fault
error_codes.safety: Torch may be hot. Switch off the welding power source.
steps: Robot safety stop, power source off.
Check and replace contact tip M6 1.0 mm.
Check wire feed rolls 1.0 mm for wear.
Blow out the wire liner with compressed air.
Re-thread the wire, weld a test seam.

error_codes.title: Shielding gas flow too low
error_codes.safety: Secure the gas cylinder against falling over.
steps: Check cylinder pressure on the gauge; below 10 bar = replace cylinder.
Clean gas nozzle, apply anti-spatter spray.
Check hose with leak detection spray.
Set flow to 12–15 l/min.
